notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957076/fbb0053fbc367490005f0ae7c166203462c2655d.png[/img]

[h2]New features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Added a new option to change the control style for PuPaiPo Space 3D[/b] , you can now switch from "Clockwise" (default) to "Left/Right" , the new control scheme is position based and you'll move left/right relative to whether you are on the top or bottom part of the stage.
[*] [b]Added a new difficulty setting to YDPPPRHL[/b] , it's a slider that goes from 10% to 300% , being 100% the default difficulty setting. Decreasing this will make your character deal more damage and receive less, while increasing it will make you deal less damage and receive more. If you are curious about the specifics, damage output goes from 200% (at 10%) to 50% (at 300%) and damage received matches the difficulty %.
[/list]

[h2]YDPPPRHL Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the final demon boss had its hair missing [[very important]]
[*] Adjusted sound effects for some demons and it won't play them if you got a game over.
[*] Upgrades that increase demon damage are 50% less effective.
[*] Upgrade that makes more demons spawn adds two less demons (four before) to each wave.
[*] When at 30% or less HP, the bottom UI will flash.
[*] Defeated "eyeball demons" won't shoot bullets that aren't big enough.
[/list]

Thank you for playing!
